x-eas.doc: A choropleth on a mercator map centred by the caller, each region's name and value in its tooltip.

shapes.doc: the regions: GeoJSON features, or TopoJSON {"url" or "topology", "feature"}

rates.doc: the values: a tab-separated table (text, or {"file": F}) with a key and a value column

shape_key.doc: the shapes' key field (a feature's id)

domain.doc: the value range the colors split

projection.doc: the Vega-Lite projection; without scale and translate it fits the shapes

label.doc: the tooltip's name for a region (its key follows)

height.doc: Vega's 500 plus its 30 px top padding, the map translated down by it

description.default: An example of a custom tooltip (on a map)
description.doc: the takeaway; alt text and table-view fallback

vega.note: the map and its legend match ref/map-with-tooltip.png: mercator at scale 900 centred on [-95, 38]; Vega's 30 px top padding is a 530 px view with the map 30 px lower; the legend takes Vega's own look (bold black 11 px title, black 10 px labels, which the bin/chart theme otherwise greys and lightens). The tooltip is Vega-Lite's own (the county's key and rate): Vega's custom tooltip, a rounded group following the pointer that redraws the hovered county under a second projection centred on its inverted centroid, has no Vega-Lite form; it only draws on hover, so the static reference does not show it. Against the vg2png (node-canvas) reference, re-measured in eas-7r1.12b with rsvg-convert and Arimo: ratio 0.0008 (was 0.0073 with the theme's legend look); the rest is glyph rasterization of the legend text.
